5056095713245.baseName: True Products 7ft Norway Spruce Artificial Christmas Tree
5056095713245.variantName: True Products 7ft Norway Spruce Artificial Christmas Tree
5056095713245.sourceDescription:
Make room for a Christmas favourite with our Norway Spruce Artificial Christmas Tree. Its full foliage and generous proportions create a beautiful focal point, ready to fill with sparkling lights and decorations collected over the years. Available in heights, 6ft and 7ft.

This tree brings a wonderfully abundant look to your festive home. A blend of realistic PE tips and PVC tips creates natural-looking texture and fullness, forming a rich backdrop for your chosen ornaments.

This unlit Norway Spruce leaves the styling entirely to you. Pair delicate warm white lights with neutral ornaments for an understated look, or embrace colourful baubles and festive garlands for a tree full of personality.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, while the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Take time to gently separate the branches and shape the individual tips, bringing out the tree's fullness before adding your finishing touches.

Features:
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 Unlit – ready for your own choice of lights
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 7ft / 2.1m
Diameter: 152cm
Tip count: 2552 (1462 PE and 1090 PVC)
Lights and decorations not included
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: White. Product measurements: width 10.6 cm, height 10.6 cm. Quantity: 36 pack.
Reusable artificial Christmas tree decoration with snowflake detail for festive home display.
White plastic construction with glitter finish adds textured winter-themed accent to seasonal arrangements.
Compact size of 10.6 cm width and height, ideal for creating focal points in coordinated decor.
Pack of 36 pieces allows for extensive decorative coverage across multiple displays or rooms.
Guarantee - 1 month
Comes pre-assembled
Without stand

Product Features
Metal Stand: Christmas tree uses metal stand instead of cheap plastic stand, and add a plastic cover on the end of the stand. Through this design, all we want to achieve is to add the stability of the tree and protect your floor.

Eco-friendly Material: The blades of this Christmas tree are made from high-quality PVC material, which not only makes the tree looks more real and more full but also adds the anti-crush capacity to the tree. Enjoy a festive glow with the 7ft Pre-lit Slim Wildhorn Pine. This elegant artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 400 multi-function warm white LED lights in a slender shape, making it a lovely choice for smaller living rooms, apartments and cosy corners.
Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Slim Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. It offers a beautifully full look within a narrow silhouette.
It has gently upswept branches and a slim, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 7ft tall, it brings height to your festive display while keeping its footprint compact. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display.
The tree comes in three sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles.

This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The yellow finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the dark green fern foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 12 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

5056797098145.variantName: MySmartBuy Pre-Lit Pop Up Christmas Tree, Snow Flocked with Silver Baubles
5056797098145.sourceDescription:
Get your home festive in minutes with this pre-lit, pre-decorated pop up Christmas tree from MySmartBuy. The snow flocked branches are already trimmed with silver baubles in shiny, matt and glitter finishes and lit with warm white LEDs, so it looks beautifully styled the moment it is up. It assembles in minutes with no fiddly branches to shape or decorations to hang, making it ideal for busy households, flats, offices, shops and retail displays. When the season is over, it is just as quick to pack away. The built-in timer takes care of switching it on and off, for effortless seasonal lighting. Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. At a glance: pop up tree | snow flocked | pre-decorated with silver shiny, matt and glitter baubles | warm white LEDs | assembles in minutes | timer | indoor use.
PRE-DECORATED POP UP TREE : Snow flocked branches trimmed with silver baubles in shiny, matt and glitter finishes.
WARM WHITE LEDS : Pre-lit for a cosy festive glow with no strings of lights to untangle.
ASSEMBLES IN MINUTES : Pop it up for quick, hassle-free decorating, and pack it away just as easily.
BUILT-IN TIMER : Takes care of switching on and off for effortless seasonal lighting.
INDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE : Ideal for homes, flats, offices, shops and retail displays.

5056589107345.variantName: 90cm USB Powered Light up The Snowman Fabric Christmas Tree Skirt with LEDs
5056589107345.sourceDescription:
Bring a touch of timeless Christmas charm to your home with this 90cm USB Powered Light up The Snowman Tree Skirt. Featuring a delightful illuminated design inspired by the beloved classic The Snowman, this festive tree skirt adds warmth, nostalgia and a soft glow to the base of your Christmas tree.

Crafted from soft fabric and measuring 90cm in diameter, this decorative tree skirt beautifully conceals tree stands while enhancing your festive display. The enchanting Snowman pattern is brought to life with integrated LEDs, creating a gentle illuminated effect that adds a magical finishing touch to your seasonal décor.

USB powered for convenience, the skirt includes a 1.5m cable lead, allowing for flexible placement around your tree. Please note that the USB plug is not supplied, giving you the option to connect it to a compatible adapter, power bank or USB port as needed. The built-in timer function automatically keeps the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, ensuring your display shines beautifully each evening without the need for manual switching.

Please note fabric tree skirts are not suitable for use with fibre optic trees.

Suitable for indoor use only.

Product Specifications
Warm White LEDs
90cm Diameter
USB Powered with 1.5m Cable
Timer Function 6 hours on 18 hours off
Charming Snowman Design: Features a beautifully illuminated The Snowman pattern inspired by the beloved Christmas classic, adding a nostalgic festive touch.
Soft Fabric Finish: Made from a 90cm diameter fabric tree skirt that neatly conceals your tree stand while enhancing your seasonal display.
USB Powered Convenience: Easily powered via USB (plug not supplied), allowing flexible connection to a power bank, adapter or USB port.
Built-In Timer Function: Automatically switches the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, offering effortless daily operation and energy efficiency.
Flexible Setup with 1.5m Cable: Includes a generous 1.5m lead for easy positioning around your tree and adaptable placement in any festive setting.
Fabric tree skirts are not suitable for use with fibre-optic trees
For Indoor Use

With ease of use in mind, the base collar requires no assembly, ensuring you spend more time enjoying the season rather than setting up. Perfect for indoor and outdoor use, its unique adaptability means it offers year-round aesthetic appeal, especially during festivities. Whether used in bustling common areas or serene outdoor settings, this tree base collar is indispensable for anyone looking to enrich their holiday aesthetic with subtle sophistication and style.

5056141073545.baseName: 60mm Pack of 18 Shatterproof Dark Grey Christmas Baubles with Mixed Finishes for Tree and Home Decorations
5056141073545.variantName: 60mm Pack of 18 Shatterproof Dark Grey Christmas Baubles with Mixed Finishes for Tree and Home Decorations
5056141073545.sourceDescription:
Create a polished festive display with this pack of 18 dark grey Christmas baubles, designed to add texture and shine to your seasonal decorating. The set includes an assortment of glitter, matte and shiny finishes, helping you build a balanced look on your Christmas tree, wreaths, garlands or other indoor and outdoor displays. Each bauble measures approximately 6cm and includes a silver top with a silver string loop attached for easy hanging. Made from durable plastic, these decorations offer a shatterproof alternative to traditional glass ornaments, giving you a stylish finish with added peace of mind. Their versatile design makes them suitable for a wide range of festive settings, from the tree and mantel to windows, porches and patios. Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
